text:
mira-k: Heads-up — nightly eval (quantized-1.2) shows a big spike for the 'legal_contracts' prompt set. Avg ROUGE dropped ~12 points vs float32 baseline. Sample diff and logs below.

sam-nguyen: Can you paste the exact harness command and run id so I can reproduce?

mira-k: Command I used:
```
./run_eval.py --model quantized-1.2 --prompts data/legal_contracts.csv --run-id nightly-2026-03-20-q 
```
Run id: nightly-2026-03-20-q.
Summary snippet (quantized vs float32):
```
model          rouge-1
float32        0.62
quantized-1.2  0.50  <-- big drop
```
One failing sample I pasted into logs shows the model's generated text compared against a reference that clearly doesn't match the prompt.

leo-dev: That smells like a prompt->reference alignment issue in the harness. Did the CSV have a header? Any extra commas?

mira-k: No header. Got the CSV from content ops; I just inspected the end of the file and saw something weird, pasted below: 
```csv
"Prompt A","Ref A"
"Prompt B","Ref B"
...
"Prompt N","Ref N",
"Prompt N+1","Ref N+1"
```
Note the trailing comma on the N row.

ci-bot: CI: nightly-harness-tests passed for main (no changes).

sam-nguyen: Quick check — run a tiny csv inspection: 
```bash
python - <<'PY'
import csv
with open('data/legal_contracts.csv') as f:
    rows=list(csv.reader(f))
    print(rows[-5:])
PY
```
If that trailing comma produces an extra empty column you'll see rows like `["Prompt N","Ref N", ""]`.

mira-k: Ran that — yep, that's exactly what's happening. After the trailing-empty-column row, the harness starts pairing prompts with the wrong references (shifted). Reproduced locally with `--seed 42 --deterministic` and deterministic scoring; the mismatch is deterministic once the CSV is malformed.

ops-bot: Ops note: rerunning nightly with cleaned CSV to confirm baseline.

mira-k: Reran with cleaned CSV (removed trailing commas) — metrics returned to expected baseline (quantized ~0.61). So this is a harness parsing bug, not model degradation.

leo-dev: Proposed fix: change the eval harness CSV loader to validate row length == 2 and drop/trim empty trailing columns. Also add a pre-flight check that asserts total prompt count == reference count and fail early with a helpful message. Will add unit test with a sample CSV that includes a trailing comma.

sam-nguyen: Sounds good. Can you open a PR with the patch + regression test + a short note in changelog? Tag me (@sam-nguyen) for review. Also add an alert in the nightly job to error out (not silently continue) when pre-flight validation fails.

mira-k: Will do. Opening PR now and adding the malformed CSV as a regression fixture. Temporary mitigation: cleaned CSV was used for tonight's rerun. I'll post the PR link in this thread once it's up. :thumbsup:
